intro: Popular, recently updated mods from ficsit.app, the official Satisfactory Mod Repository. Install them with Satisfactory Mod Manager, which adds SML and every library a mod needs. All of these are marked Works for the stable branch on ficsit.app as of the verified date.

mods.name: Satisfactory Mod Loader (SML)
mods.summary: The mod loader every code mod needs. SMM installs and updates it for you.
mods.note: Don't install it by hand; let the mod manager pick the version.

mods.name: Satisfactory Mod Manager
mods.summary: Installs mods, dependencies and SML, with profiles you can share for multiplayer.

mods.name: Smart!
mods.summary: Build grids of foundations, walls and machines in one go, with auto-connected belts and power.
mods.note: Very popular; check its ficsit.app page after big game updates.

mods.name: Infinite Zoop
mods.summary: Raises the zoop (drag-build) limit and lets you zoop in two directions at once.

mods.name: Infinite Nudge
mods.summary: Nudge, rotate and scale buildables in finer steps and on any axis while placing them.

mods.name: Refined Power
mods.summary: Adds 30+ power buildings, including solar, wind, hydro and nuclear options.

mods.name: Structural Solutions
mods.summary: 300+ extra building pieces: foundations, walls, ramps and decorative parts.

mods.name: Linear Motion
mods.summary: Elevators and other moving platforms for getting around tall factories.

mods.name: Efficiency Checker Mod
mods.summary: Shows whether a production line is under- or over-supplied, with a buildable and a hand tool.

mods.name: Modular Load Balancers
mods.summary: Snap-together splitter blocks that build even load balancers without the usual spaghetti.

mods.name: Throughput Counter and Limiter
mods.summary: A belt attachment that shows real items per minute and can cap belt throughput.

mods.name: Ficsit Farming
mods.summary: Grow crops and raise animals as new production chains.

mods.name: MiniMap
mods.summary: Adds a minimap to your HUD.
